title: Explorer entries
what: The system-only entries another unit reads the web through: a page drawn and imported whole, a raster picture, a page head and the engines' states. Lives in src/tools/explorer.rs and tools/explorer/.

title: Run launching tools
what: What the browse and remote_browser entries share: the turn a call is made in, the sync or async mode, and the run handed to the bmo-explorer unit command. Lives in src/tools/launching.rs.

title: research_branch tool
what: The entry a search run opens a research branch by, asked of the record's web helper. Lives in src/tools/research_branch.rs and tools/research_branch/.

title: web_fetch tool
what: The web namespace's page reading: an address a site tool claims answered by that tool through the host, every other page read by the record's web helper. Lives in src/tools/web_fetch.rs and tools/web_fetch/.

title: web_search tool
what: The web namespace's search entry, asked of the record's web helper. Lives in src/tools/web_search.rs and tools/web_search/.
